description: Agent GovCon: submit a proposal, quote or bid with the solicitation it answers: the response with its reference, the solicitation number it cites, the offeror, each volume or section with its pages and smallest font size, each form with whether it is signed, each certification or representation with whether it is signed, and the price with its contract type and the line items it covers; the solicitation with its number, each required volume or section with its page limit, a page limit across the response, the smallest font size allowed, each required form, each certification required signed, and the contract type and line items of its pricing schedule. The signed report gives the response and the solicitation, each required section found or missing, each page limit and the font minimum read against the response, each required form and certification found with its signature, and the price structure read against the schedule with each line item left unpriced or added, and counts them, and names a divergent response: a required section, form or certification missing, a page or format rule the response breaks, a required certification unsigned, and a price offered in a contract type or line items unlike the pricing schedule; then another solicitation number and an unsigned form, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No required sections, no page or font rule with pages to read, no required forms or certifications, a certification with no signature stated, or no contract type or line items on both sides leaves those points unverified. Sections read by their words with plurals folded, forms by their number or words, and line items by their letters and digits. This reads the response as prepared against the solicitation. Verdict govcon_proposal_divergent, govcon_proposal_partial, govcon_proposal_unverified or govcon_proposal_consistent. POST /api/govcon-proposal-check. Reads the government contracting records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between contracting documents only: it never submits a bid or proposal, never registers or certifies a vendor in any government system, never contacts an agency and never decides eligibility or award, which stay with the contracting agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent GovCon reads government contracting records across the procurement lifecycle for consistency between the documents and the terms they answer to: a solicitation, a vendor’s eligibility record, a proposal or bid, a price proposal or pricing volume, an award notice, a contract modification, a deliverable or progress report and an invoice or payment voucher, each against its own sections and the notice it follows, the solicitation’s set-aside, eligibility, submission and pricing terms, the winning price and eligibility record, the base award and prior modifications, the deliverable schedule, or the payment terms and acceptance record it should agree with. The family reads procurement, the government buying goods and services under contract terms, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-govcon-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-govcon/.
